page:
Migration guide from rolldown-vite (Vite 7 with Rolldown) to Vite 8.
- rolldown-vite: technical preview release for Rolldown integrated Vite v6 & v7
- Vite 8 uses Rolldown and Oxc instead of esbuild and Rollup
- Default browser target changes: Chrome 107→111, Edge 107→111, Firefox 104→114, Safari 16.0→16.4
- Baseline Widely Available feature sets as of 2026-01-01 (two and a half years old)
- Gradual migration: rolldown-vite package for intermediate step
- Undo rolldown-vite in package.json devDependencies, update to vite ^8.0.0
- Dependency optimizer: now uses Rolldown instead of esbuild
- optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions deprecated, convert to optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions automatically
- JavaScript transforms: Oxc instead of esbuild
- esbuild option deprecated, convert to oxc option automatically
- esbuild.jsx → oxc.jsx transformations
- esbuild.supported not supported by Oxc, see oxc-project/oxc#15373
- Oxc doesn't support lowering native decorators yet, waiting for spec, see oxc-project/oxc#9170
- Babel/SWC workaround available for decorators
- esbuild optional dependency now, install if plugins use transformWithEsbuild
- transformWithEsbuild deprecated, use transformWithOxc instead
- Oxc Minifier for JavaScript minification
- build.minify: 'esbuild' deprecated, switch back option available (install esbuild)
- CSS Minification: Lightning CSS by default instead of esbuild
- build.cssMinify: 'esbuild' option available (install esbuild)
- Consistent CommonJS interop for default imports
- Module type support auto detection by Rolldown
- build.rollupOptions → build.rolldownOptions
- worker.rollupOptions → worker.rolldownOptions
- build.commonjsOptions now no-op
- build.dynamicImportVarsOptions.warnOnError now no-op
- resolve.alias[].customResolver deprecated, use custom plugin with resolveId hook
- import.meta.hot.accept with URL no longer supported, pass id instead
How do I migrate from Vite 7 to 8? What changed with bundler tools? How do I handle esbuild deprecation? What's the Oxc minifier? How do I migrate CSS minification?

sections.manifest:
Default browser target updates in Vite 8.
- Chrome: 107 → 111
- Edge: 107 → 111
- Firefox: 104 → 114
- Safari: 16.0 → 16.4
- Baseline Widely Available: 2026-01-01
- Released about two and a half years ago
What are the new default browser targets?

Rolldown integration and dependency optimizer changes.
- Vite 8 uses Rolldown (https://rolldown.rs/) and Oxc (https://oxc.rs/)
- Replaces esbuild and Rollup
- rolldown-vite: intermediate step for gradual migration from Vite 7
- Dependency optimizer: Rolldown instead of esbuild
- optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions deprecated, auto-converts to optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions
- Conversion mappings: minify, treeShaking, define, loader, preserveSymlinks, resolveExtensions, mainFields, conditions, keepNames, platform, plugins
- configResolved hook: access config.optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions
How does Rolldown replace esbuild and Rollup?

JavaScript transforms with Oxc.
- Oxc replaces esbuild for JavaScript transformation
- esbuild option deprecated, auto-converts to oxc option
- jsx transformations: preserve, automatic (runtime), transform/classic (pragma/pragmaFrag)
- jsxImportSource → oxc.jsx.importSource
- jsxFactory → oxc.jsx.pragma
- jsxFragment → oxc.jsx.pragmaFrag
- jsxDev → oxc.jsx.development
- jsxSideEffects → oxc.jsx.pure
- define, banner, footer options conversion
- esbuild.supported not supported by Oxc (oxc-project/oxc#15373)
- Native decorators: not supported, waiting for spec (oxc-project/oxc#9170)
- Babel/SWC workaround: @rolldown/plugin-babel or @rollup/plugin-swc
- @babel/plugin-proposal-decorators version: '2023-11'
How do I migrate esbuild options to Oxc?

JavaScript minification with Oxc.
- Oxc Minifier for JavaScript minification
- build.minify: 'esbuild' deprecated, install esbuild as devDependency if needed
- esbuild.minify* options → build.rolldownOptions.output.minify
- esbuild.drop → build.rolldownOptions.output.minify.compress.drop*
- Property mangling not supported by Oxc (mangleProps, reserveProps, mangleQuoted, mangleCache) (oxc-project/oxc#15375)
- Minifier assumptions differ: see esbuild vs Oxc comparison
How do I handle JavaScript minification changes?

CSS minification with Lightning CSS.
- Lightning CSS: default CSS minifier instead of esbuild
- build.cssMinify: 'esbuild' option available (install esbuild)
- Better syntax lowering
- CSS bundle size might increase slightly
How do I handle CSS minification changes?

CommonJS interop consistency changes.
- Default import from CJS: consistent behavior across dev and build
- Conditions for default = module.exports: .mjs/.mts file, package.json type: 'module', __esModule not set to true
- Otherwise: default = module.exports.default
- Previous behavior different in dev vs build
- legacy.inconsistentCjsInterop: true: restore old behavior (deprecated)
- Report affected packages to package author
- Link to Rolldown docs for context
How do I handle CJS interop changes?

Removed module resolution format sniffing.
- browser and module fields no longer used heuristically
- Always respects resolve.mainFields order
- Use resolve.alias or package manager patches (patch-package, pnpm patch) if needed
What changed with module resolution?

Require calls for externalized modules.
- require() calls for externalized modules now preserved
- No longer converted to import statements
- esmExternalRequirePlugin available for conversion if needed
- Re-exported from vite or rolldown/builtin-plugins
How do I handle externalized module requires?

import.meta.url in UMD/IIFE.
- No longer polyfilled in UMD/IIFE output
- Replaced with undefined by default
- Use define option with build.rolldownOptions.output.intro for custom behavior
How do I handle import.meta.url in UMD/IIFE?

Removed and deprecated Rollup options.
- build.rollupOptions.watch.chokidar removed, migrate to build.rolldownOptions.watch.watcher
- build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks: object form removed, function form deprecated
- build.rolldownOptions.codeSplitting: more flexible replacement
- build() throws BundleError instead of raw error, access .errors array
- Module type support and auto detection by Rolldown
- moduleType: 'js' for custom loaders
- build.rollupOptions → build.rolldownOptions (deprecated)
- worker.rollupOptions → worker.rolldownOptions (deprecated)
- build.commonjsOptions (no-op)
- build.dynamicImportVarsOptions.warnOnError (no-op)
- resolve.alias[].customResolver (deprecated, use plugin with resolveId hook)
What Rollup options were removed or deprecated?

Advanced breaking changes for plugin authors.
- Extglobs not yet supported (rolldown-vite#365)
- TypeScript legacy namespace: partial support only
- define: no object reference sharing (each variable gets copy)
- bundle object changes: no assignment (use this.emitFile), reference not shared across hooks, structuredClone errors
- Parallel hooks work as sequential (Rolldown limitation)
- 'use strict' not injected sometimes
- ES5 and below transformation not supported with plugin-legacy (rolldown-vite#452)
- Passing same browser multiple versions to build.target: now errors
- Rolldown missing features: system format, amd format, shouldTransformCachedModule, resolveImportMeta, renderDynamicImport, resolveFileUrl hooks
- parseAst/parseAstAsync deprecated, use parseSync/parse instead
- Comments removed before renderChunk hook (after in Rollup)
- Comments outside removal scope moved (not removed like Rollup)
What advanced changes affect plugin authors?
